name: OMNI Real Estate Token
rootCause: The OMNI Real Estate Token (ORT) project on BSC was attacked. The cause of the attack is suspected to be a loophole in the contract code. The attacker’s address is: 0x9BbD94506398a1459F0Cd3B2638512627390255e, one of the attack contracts is 0x0eFfECA3dBCBcda4d5e4515829b0d42181700606, the initial gas source of the attack is FixedFloat, and the attacker made more than 236 BNB, worth about $57.
